name: yf_index_history
description:
Daily history for one market index from Yahoo Finance.
Returns: {index, period, data_points (all days in the period), truncated, prices: the most recent limit days, oldest first, each {Date, Open, High, Low, Close, Volume, Dividends, Stock Splits}}.
Inputs (* required): index (Yahoo index symbol, e.g. ^GSPC, ^DJI, ^IXIC, ^RUT; default ^GSPC); period (1mo, 3mo, 6mo, 1y, 5y, ytd, max, ...; default 1y); limit (days, 1-1000; default 260, about one year).
Latest levels: yf_market_summary; other source: openbb_index_price_historical.
Example: {"index": "^IXIC", "period": "3mo"}
